app.name: Conductor
app.primary_job: Read agent work, edit a project, and manage chats

screen.name: Workspace
screen.purpose: Read a conversation and inspect project changes beside it

layout_header_overhead.instructions: For a conversation workspace, how much of the area above the transcript is spent on navigation and controls that serve the current work? Exclude the operating-system menu bar.
criteria: An extra full-width application-branding row or repeated toolbar information consumes space above the workspace header and chat tabs.
There is no extra branding row, but secondary configuration or help actions take persistent space alongside the everyday controls.
The workspace header and chat tabs carry the necessary identity, state and navigation; secondary configuration and help are disclosed in menus or on demand.

layout_transcript_composer_alignment.instructions: In a conversation workspace, how do the leading edges of message text and the composer input relate? Judge their actual positions, allowing for normal content padding.
criteria: Message text starts far inside the composer leading edge, forming two separate horizontal tracks.
The tracks mostly align, but differences in padding make their leading edges visibly inconsistent.
Message text and composer input share a leading edge, apart from consistent small content padding.
